title: Make Dailymotion subtitles bigger
question: How do I increase the subtitle size on Dailymotion?
answer: Dailymotion's player menu can turn subtitles on and off and pick a language, but it has no setting for their size, so use a userscript. The usermods script on this page makes subtitles in the Dailymotion player 60% bigger, on dailymotion.com and on other sites that embed the player. Change the SCALE number at the top of the script to pick another size. Fullscreen does not help much: the player stops growing subtitles at a fixed size.
prompt: Make the subtitles in the Dailymotion video player bigger.
details:
The player runs in its own frame on geo.dailymotion.com and sets the subtitle size in a CSS variable, smaller in a small player and up to a fixed maximum in a large one. The script multiplies that size by `SCALE` (1.6 by default), so subtitles still scale with the player.

The check opens the player page for a video, turns English subtitles on, and confirms the text is 1.6 times its normal size. The script only works where your userscript manager runs scripts inside frames, which is needed for the player on dailymotion.com itself.

evidence.note: Greasy Fork total installs: "Daily Motion Subtitle Size Increaser" (255)

check.baseline: (() => { const ph = document.querySelector('.subtitles_placeholder'); const line = ph && ph.querySelector('div'); return !!line && line.checkVisibility() && line.textContent.trim().length > 0 && parseFloat(getComputedStyle(line).fontSize) <= 24; })()
check.expect: (() => { const ph = document.querySelector('.subtitles_placeholder'); const line = ph && ph.querySelector('div'); const base = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).fontSize) * 1.5; return !!line && line.checkVisibility() && line.textContent.trim().length > 0 && Math.abs(parseFloat(getComputedStyle(line).fontSize) - base * 1.6) < 1; })()
check.intact: (() => { const v = document.querySelector('video'); return !!v && v.currentTime > 2 && !v.paused && v.checkVisibility(); })()
